landing.title: Taxes
landing.subtitle: Tools for the deductions and taxes that shape your pay

payrollDeductions.title: Payroll Deductions
payrollDeductions.description: Set yearly maximums on deductions such as pension and employment insurance, and let the paycheque stop collecting them once the maximum is reached.

payroll.title: Payroll Deductions
payroll.subtitle: Yearly maximums on the deduction lines of your payroll bill

emptyState.title: No deduction rules yet
emptyState.body: Pick the scheduled bill that is your paycheque, choose its deduction categories and set a yearly maximum for each. The bill stops collecting a deduction once its maximum is reached and starts again on the reset date.

yearToDate.title: Paid this period
yearToDate.help: What the category has collected in the period that contains today, across every account, in the bill's currency.
yearToDate.foreignRows: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in another currency not counted

previousPeriods.title: Previous Periods
previousPeriods.help: What each category collected in its past periods, across every account, in the bill's currency. The current period is in the year-to-date table.
previousPeriods.empty: Nothing collected in an earlier period yet.

form.billPlaceholder: Select the bill that is your paycheque
form.billHelp: The scheduled deposit whose lines carry the deductions. Only bills that pay in more than they take out are offered, and only their deduction lines can be capped.
form.yearlyMaximumHelp: The most this category collects in one period, in the bill's currency. The line is reduced to what room is left, down to zero.
form.yearlyMaximumSuggested: Estimated from what this category has already collected.
form.resetDateHelp: The count starts again on this day each year. Usually the first day of the year.
form.expectedHelp: The bill's line for this category is zero, so the forecast needs the amount each paycheque usually deducts.
form.expectedFromLine: The bill's line deducts {amount} per paycheque.
form.expectedSuggested: Suggested from the amount your transactions in this category most often show over the last year.
form.setNextPeriod: Set the figures for the next period, from {date}
form.nextYearlyMaximumHelp: The maximum from the next reset on. Leave it empty to keep this period's maximum. This period's room and percentage do not change.
form.nextExpectedHelp: The amount each paycheque deducts from the next reset on. Leave it empty to keep this period's amount.

validation.expectedRequired: Enter the expected amount per paycheque
validation.categoryDuplicate: This category is already in the list

form.noDeductionLines: This bill has no deduction lines. Add the deductions as negative split lines on the bill first.

delete.title: Delete Deduction Rule
delete.message: Delete the {category} rule on {bill}? Posted transactions are not changed; the next paycheque posts its full line.

toasts.created: {count, plural, one {Deduction rule created} other {# deduction rules created}}
toasts.createFailed: Failed to create the deduction rule
toasts.updateFailed: Failed to update the deduction rule
toasts.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the deduction rule
